theorem answer : YM.Bid.A08 := by
  intro G L S H V hincl hV _ Y hY h her
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := her
  have hlarge (d : ℕ) (hd : N ≤ d) : defect Y d = 0 :=
    hN d hd (defect Y d) (defect_winds h d)
      fun m _ hx u v w => defect_ward H hV (hY m) hx u v w
  intro d u v
  rw [← sub_eq_zero]
  change defect Y d u v = 0
  apply LinearMap.ext
  intro w
  -- Inject this cap into one of the large caps.
  have hd : d ≤ max d N := le_max_left d N
  apply V.inject H.laws.toSymmetric hincl hd
  rw [← defect_rise h hd u v w, hlarge _ (le_max_right d N)]
  simp

proof_context.conclusion: `answer` shows the defect vanishes in large degrees by `defect_ward` (vanishing correlation sums) and the erasure test, then in all lower degrees by injective inclusions (`V.inject`, `defect_rise`).
`A07` gives `erases H.spin V`, the finite free tests that are injective on the defect space in large degree.
